title: [BUG] protein research & Usage Policy
body:
## Environment
- Claude Code 

## Bug Description
 Project: Scientific analysis software for protein research laboratory

  Problem: Cannot discuss implementation of quality control features for standard laboratory reagents used in protein preservation during freeze-drying process.

  Specific blockers:
  - Discussing m/z values for standard sugars (sucrose, trehalose) and amino acids (glycine, arginine)
  - Modifying existing JavaScript database of laboratory contaminants
  - These are routine pharmaceutical ingredients, not controlled substances

  Impact: Unable to complete legitimate scientific software development for accredited lab

  Request: Guidance on how to proceed with scientific/analytical chemistry discussions
author: hbanaharis
